rationale: Base station storage is at 99% with loop recording disabled, triggering error E-402 and the solid purple LED (storage >95%). Per the manual, when loop recording is disabled and storage reaches 98%, new events are not recorded, which explains why the timeline stops at the end of last month while live view and notifications (which don't write new clips) still work. This is unrelated to the firmware update and is resolvable by enabling loop recording or formatting storage after exporting clips.

repair_steps: Guide customer to open the app and go to Base Station Settings > Storage.
Instruct customer to enable Loop Recording to automatically overwrite oldest clips when storage is full.
If customer prefers to keep existing clips, instruct them to export important clips first, then format storage.
Confirm that the purple LED turns off and error E-402 clears after enabling loop recording or formatting.
Advise customer to verify that new events are recorded and appear on the timeline.
output.customer_reply: Your base station's storage is full (99%), and loop recording is off, so new events aren't being saved. This caused the purple light and the timeline stopping. To fix, enable Loop Recording in Base Station Settings > Storage, or export important clips and format storage. After that, new recordings will resume and the light will return to normal.

results.text: Base station storage at or above 98 percent with loop recording disabled. Frontline action: enable loop recording or format storage.

Event clips are stored on the base station's internal eMMC (HB-100: 16 GB, HB-200: 32 GB). When loop recording is disabled and storage reaches 98 percent, new events are not recorded and error E-402 is shown. Enable loop recording in Base Station Settings > Storage, or format the storage after exporting clips.

Solid blue: online and connected to cloud. Blinking blue: pairing mode (lasts 120 seconds). Solid red: no internet uplink. Blinking red: booting or firmware update in progress, do not unplug. Solid purple: storage almost full (over 95 percent).

lines: storage used 99%; loop recording disabled; E-402

complaint: I went to look at the footage of a delivery from last week and the timeline stops at the end of last month. There has been a purple light on the base station for a few days that I've been ignoring. Live view and notifications still work, so I assumed the system was fine. I think the cameras stopped recording after the last firmware update.
